title: Across the Void
summary: Hongdie attacks Wang Lin on sight, and he answers with his Life and Death domain, calling her unfilial for abandoning her parents, cruel for wiping out four sects, and disloyal for selling Xue Yue to the Suzaku Country. Chi Hu stops the fight and makes them agree to share the spoils equally. Hongdie freezes the Cold Stream for three days so they can cross, and the trio rides Chi Hu's flawed Star Compass into the void of the Rain Celestial Realm. Wang Lin recognises a void beast called Xu and warns them to flee north; Chi Hu ignores him at first and the compass is badly damaged. On foot they reach a rare overlapping fragment marked by the Giant Demon ancestors, but the jade coffin and immortal sword on the second layer are gone, and Zhou Yi of the Five Elements Sect appears.
